hints: Fill the blanks in a fixed order, one at a time. What has to be true of the digit you write before you move on to the next blank?
It must not already appear in that cell's row, column or box. Checking that before recursing is what makes the search finish.
When no digit fits a blank, the grid is wrong further back: undo the last write and try the next digit there. That undo is the backtracking.
Three arrays of nine bit masks - one per row, one per column, one per box - make each check a single bit test, and each write and undo a single flip.
